01 — Who's behind the lab

About the Lab

One builder.
One lab. Zero boring software.

AslyLabs is the product studio of Anmol Agrawal — a B.Tech CSE (AI) undergrad at Galgotias College of Engineering & Technology, Greater Noida, and a full-stack developer who would rather ship a product than polish a résumé.

Everything under the AslyLabs roof follows one rule: if it feels like a template, it doesn't ship. Real backends, real data, real users — from an ML-powered expense tracker to an AI that interviews you back.

03 — Flagship build

Featured Project

Flagship — Fintech × ML

Smart Expense Tracker

A full-stack finance app that doesn't just record spending — it learns from it. A Spring Boot core, a FastAPI + ML layer for smart categorisation and insights, a React frontend and PostgreSQL underneath. The product that started AslyLabs.
